opportunity_title: Title X Family Planning Services Grants
one_line_rationale: Strong fit: Title X directly funds family planning and preconception services under DPH, advancing G2.O4 reproductive and maternal health work.

opportunity_title: Public Health Crisis Response Cooperative Agreement
one_line_rationale: Aligns with public health workforce surge staffing and DPH preparedness role; only creates an unfunded roster until CDC activates an emergency.

opportunity_title: Home Study and Post-Release Services for Unaccompanied Alien Children​​
one_line_rationale: Fits G2.O2 child safety and permanency and state child welfare expertise in DSS, but serves a federal immigration-specific population with high ORR compliance demands.

opportunity_title: Emerging Infections Network - Research for Preventing, Detecting, and Managing Travel-associated Infectious Diseases
one_line_rationale: Strong fit for DPH disease surveillance and preparedness; CDC travel-focused sentinel network advances data-driven decision-making, though it is not squarely in NCDHHS strategic goals.

opportunity_title: NARMS Cooperative Agreement Program to Strengthen Antibiotic Resistance Surveillance in Retail Food Specimens
one_line_rationale: Funds antibiotic resistance surveillance in retail food; fits DPH lab and epidemiology role but is narrow and not a named NCDHHS objective.

opportunity_title: Laboratory Flexible Funding Model (LFFM)
one_line_rationale: This FDA cooperative agreement funds state food testing laboratory capacity which fits DPH's public health laboratory and environmental health role though it is not tied to named NCDHHS strategic objective.

opportunity_title: US Travelers Health Research, Surveillance, Communication, and Outreach Network
one_line_rationale: The CDC travel health surveillance network is a moderate fit for DPH infectious disease work but only indirectly supports NCDHHS data infrastructure and health access goals.

opportunity_title: Institute of Education Sciences (IES): National Center for Special Education Research (NCSER): Using Longitudinal Data to Support State Education Policymaking in Special Education, Assistance Listing Number (ALN) 84.324S
one_line_rationale: Special education SLDS work is primarily DPI/SEA; NCDHHS fits only through early intervention and lacks the research/data-system role, so it is not a priority.

opportunity_title: BJA FY 2026 The Kevin and Avonte Program: Reducing Injury and Death of Missing Individuals with Dementia and Developmental Disabilities
one_line_rationale: This grant aligns with NCDHHS safety goals for vulnerable North Carolinians but is public-safety oriented and would require cross-division and law enforcement partners.

opportunity_title: Announcement of Stand Down Grants
one_line_rationale: State agencies are eligible, but this small, veteran-specific DOL event falls outside NCDHHS core health and human services divisions; likely not worth the administrative effort.

opportunity_title: HIV Care Grant Program - Part B States/Territories Formula and AIDS Drug Assistance Program Formula and AIDS Drug Assistance Program Supplemental Awards
one_line_rationale: Core DPH work: Ryan White HIV care and AIDS Drug Assistance Program funding advances G1 health access for low-income North Carolinians with HIV.

opportunity_title: Maternal, Infant, and Early Childhood Home Visiting Program (MIECHV)
one_line_rationale: MIECHV directly funds home visiting that improves maternal and child health and birth outcomes; NCDHHS's Child and Family Well-Being division already runs home visiting, making this a strong fit.

opportunity_title: Strengthening Services to Prevent the Infectious Disease Consequences of Drug Use
one_line_rationale: Directly funds infectious disease testing and harm reduction for people who use drugs, fitting DPH disease prevention and G3.O4 substance use crisis priorities.

opportunity_title: Preschool Development Grant Birth Through Five (PDG B-5) SMART Grant
one_line_rationale: One-year federal grant would fund early childhood data and technology infrastructure, directly supporting G5.O1 and fitting DCDEE's early learning data role.

opportunity_title: National HIV Behavioral Surveillance
one_line_rationale: Funds HIV behavioral surveillance to track disparities and guide prevention, directly fitting DPH's existing disease surveillance and epidemiology role.
